description: Reverse-engineer what the trader POSTED before saying anything about it: a rule in words, a pasted Pine script (read statically, never run) or a chat transcript. Returns a dossier: the route (what it is and the first tool), findings each marked observation, inference or unknown with an id (E1, E2) and what would settle each unknown, the checklist (market, bar size, trigger, direction, stop, target, stand aside, numbers match the tape, run over recorded bars) as answered, partial or unresolved, and the ceiling (hypothesis until rehearsed). Cite the ids; never present an inference or an unknown as a fact. For an attached chart use the image tool first.

text.description: what the trader posted, verbatim: the rule, the Pine source or the transcript

name: reverse
